entries.partTitle: Frustum-Aligned Voxel Grids (Froxels): Dimensions, Logarithmic Slicing & VRAM Allocation

spec.title: System Architecture: Frustum-Aligned Voxel Grids (Froxels): Dimensions, Logarithmic Slicing & VRAM Allocation

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays frustum-aligned voxel grid volume mapped along the camera viewing cone.
Deep inspection tracks logarithmic depth distribution clustering fine voxels near the camera near plane.
Comparative analysis contrasts screen-space froxels against uniform world-space voxel allocations.
Verification confirms memory allocation limits and volume slice depth boundary equations.

entries.partTitle: Henyey-Greenstein Phase Function & Anisotropic Forward Scattering

spec.title: System Architecture: Henyey-Greenstein Phase Function & Anisotropic Forward Scattering

steps.caption: Architectural overview shows Henyey-Greenstein anisotropic phase scattering concentrating radiance forward toward the viewer.
Deep inspection evaluates phase asymmetry factors modeling aerosol fog droplets and dust motes.
Comparative analysis demonstrates dramatic forward scattering intensity compared to isotropic side scattering.
Verification certifies numerical stability and phase denominator clamping in high-energy spotlight beams.

entries.partTitle: Radiometry of Participating Media & Beer-Lambert Law Transmittance

spec.title: System Architecture: Radiometry of Participating Media & Beer-Lambert Law Transmittance

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates exponential light decay through participating media governed by the Beer-Lambert law.
Deep inspection calculates optical depth and transmittance reduction across variable atmospheric distances.
Comparative analysis benchmarks thick fog extinction against clear atmospheric transmission curves.
Verification confirms exponential transmittance limits and wavelength-dependent scatter parameters.

entries.partTitle: Front-to-Back Volume Ray Marching & In-Scatter Integration

spec.title: System Architecture: Front-to-Back Volume Ray Marching & In-Scatter Integration

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays single compute pass front-to-back integration along froxel depth columns.
Deep inspection tracks running accumulated in-scattered light and net transmittance multiplication registers.
Comparative analysis contrasts pre-integrated three-dimensional texture sampling against brute force per-pixel ray marching.
Verification certifies analytical closed-form slice integration and zero stepping banding artifacts.

entries.partTitle: Temporal Accumulation, Bilateral Upsampling & Full-Resolution Compositing

spec.title: System Architecture: Temporal Accumulation, Bilateral Upsampling & Full-Resolution Compositing

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates depth-aware bilateral upsampling of downscaled froxels onto full-resolution geometry.
Deep inspection evaluates bilateral depth weights rejecting froxels across geometric silhouette edges.
Comparative analysis confirms total elimination of edge bleeding halos around foreground characters.
Verification certifies execution times under three milliseconds and cinema-grade atmospheric visuals.
